description: The one shared rendering of a caveat list, so every page that shows a sales/revenue/complexity figure renders caveats identically rather than each page re-implementing its own formatting.
docstring:
Render a fixed expander listing every caveat.

Args:
    caveats: Typically reporting.interpretive_caveats() plus, when applicable, reporting.partial_run_caveat(...) and the 'archetype_cap_relaxed' caveat already appended by reporting.load_run_report -- this function does not itself call reporting, it only renders whatever list it is given.

Behavior:
    - An st.expander (collapsed by default, so it does not dominate the page, but always present and always labeled clearly, e.g. 'Methodology notes and limitations (N)').
    - Each Caveat rendered with its title, body, and a visual marker for severity ('info' vs 'warning' vs 'error', the last only ever appearing via a failed run's partial_run_caveat).
    - Order: caveats are rendered in the order given, not re-sorted -- callers control ordering (e.g. load_run_report puts the dynamic partial/relaxation caveats first, then the fixed interpretive_caveats list).
postconditions: Every element of caveats is rendered; none are silently dropped
severity is visually distinguishable (e.g. color or icon differs across 'info', 'warning', 'error')

edge_cases.input: caveats is empty (should not normally happen -- interpretive_caveats() always returns the fixed 7-item list -- but defensively)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: renders an empty expander rather than raising or omitting the expander entirely, so the panel's presence itself stays a reliable, testable invariant across every page

edge_cases.input: A Caveat with severity outside {'info','warning','error'} (should not occur given reporting's own contract)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: rendered with a default/neutral visual treatment rather than raising -- this function trusts but does not re-validate reporting's own severity contract

edge_cases.input: Called twice on the same page (should not happen per this page's own design, but defensively)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: renders two independent expanders; no shared state between calls

unit_tests.name: test_all_caveats_rendered
unit_tests.description: A list of 7 caveats results in 7 rendered entries inside the expander.

unit_tests.name: test_severity_visually_distinguished
unit_tests.description: An 'error' severity caveat renders with a different marker than an 'info' one.

unit_tests.name: test_order_preserved
unit_tests.description: Caveats render in the exact order passed in, not resorted.

unit_tests.name: test_empty_list_still_renders_expander
unit_tests.description: An empty caveats list still renders the expander container.
